title: Gran Torre Costanera

references.observations: 300 m completed tower; four folded tapering glass walls, separated upper corners, latticed crown. Hero photograph, crown night photograph, skydeck interior and ground-level entrance photograph were inspected directly in the browser. Crown has four projecting translucent walls with lower corner screens, horizontal steel beams and diagonal braces. Observatory has exposed pale framing. Entrance has an inclined-rod supported glass canopy, thin steel posts and pull-handle doors.
references.photoCredit: Jeff Goldberg/ESTO; images referenced, not redistributed

references.observations: Floor 60: published 249.60 m datum, 4.10 m slab interval, total 1279 m2. Plan has a facade ridge on each side and pronounced recessed corners, with north arrow and a schematic section. The drawing is explicitly marked illustrative. The outer projected envelope and occupied floor polygon are distinct.

Exterior aerial photograph: taper and recessed vertical corner strips. Owner identifies 54 office floors and 3.95 m typical interval, distinct from the floor-60 drawing's 4.10 m interval. Floor 34 and generic office plans confirm folded facades and concave corner returns.

references.publisher: Alemparte Barreda Wedeles Besancon, architect of record
references.observations: Identifies the 300 m tower as 64 floors, within a larger complex with separate towers and a six-level mall. This model represents the individual landmark, not the whole complex.
Observatory floor labels 61 and 62. Marketing language describing 300 m does not establish their exact floor elevations.
